senses.gloss: m. sing. a. pl. (a comp. of דרי to carry, a. pl. of פִּתְקָא; cmp. מקבלי פתקין Sabb. X, 4) bag for official documents, mail bag.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 99b:2">Snh. 99ᵇ</cite> [read with Ms. M.] <he>כולהו גופי ד׳ נינהו טוביה לדזכי והוי ד׳ דאורייתא שנ׳ כי … בבטנך</he> (Ar. <cite ref="D01119"><he>דרפתקי</he></cite>) all human bodies are mail bags (carrying the decrees of the Lord); happy they who are found worthy to be receptacles of the Law, as it says &c. (<cite ref="Proverbs 22:18">Prov. XXII, 18</cite>).
